args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (unhealthy, error rate 18% across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate 0.2%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 was promoted, so the release process should be reviewed. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I skipped v2.3.1-rc because it only ran in staging, and it was unhealthy there too.
- **After:** all three regions are on v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 covers the failure, the rollback and the post-rollback health check. It also notes that v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production, so the release process should be reviewed. The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again.
